       case when fim is null then 'em andamento' else 'encerrada' end as situacao,
       (select count(*) from leituras l where l.rodada_id = r.id) as leituras

panels.title: Média por caso ($janela)

targets.rawSql:
select caso,
       count(*) as rodadas,
       avg(media_mq3_raw) as "MQ-3", avg(media_mq135_raw) as "MQ-135", avg(media_humidity_pct) as "Umidade (%)", avg(media_temperature_c) as "Temperatura (°C)"
from v_media_rodada
where janela = '$janela' and n_leituras > 0 and caso in ($caso) and participante in ($participante) and (coalesce(origem, '') <> 'simulador' or '$incluir_simulador' = 'sim')
group by caso
order by caso
